player_prompt.intro:
Tirid taɣḍft n Slitherlink ɣef {R}x{C} tiɣri!
Aẓẓul ṭṭerf n yiwen umḍin s igenni, iɣil d akk tiggtin n uṭṭun s tinṭṭi n isḍafen.
Beddel isḍafen s:
  [h r c] - beddel asḍaf aɣziw f llid n tiggtin ɣef uṣṭṭu r, tamḍla c
  [v r c] - beddel asḍaf aɣersiw f tama n tiggtin ɣef uṣṭṭu r, tamḍla c
Inṭṭi n uṭṭun mmalen-d tiɣzi n isḍafen ilḥan, '.' anɣil amnaḍ.
Tella-k d akk {max_turns} imḍinen ad tettusḍaf tiɣḍft.
